name: Box Squat
cue_notes: Sit back to the box, pause without relaxing, drive up through the floor.

name: Belt Squat
cue_notes: Loads through the hips, not the spine — primary substitute for barbell squat with lumbar or 90-degree knee flexion limits.

name: Front Squat
cue_notes: Elbows high, torso stays upright, bar rests on front delts.

name: Zercher Squat
cue_notes: Bar cradled in elbow crease, keeps torso upright without wrist demand of front squat.

name: Overhead Squat
cue_notes: Highest technical demand squat variant — bar locked overhead throughout descent.

name: Landmine Squat
cue_notes: Hold bar at chest, sits into a more upright, knee-friendly squat pattern.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
cue_notes: Elbows inside knees at bottom, drive floor apart with feet.

name: Kettlebell Front Rack Squat
cue_notes: One or two kettlebells racked at shoulders, elbows tucked.

name: Bodyweight Squat
cue_notes: Sit back and down, knees track over toes, chest stays tall.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
cue_notes: Rear foot elevated, front shin stays vertical, control the descent.

name: Walking Lunge
cue_notes: Step through, drop rear knee toward the floor, drive through front heel.

name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
cue_notes: Same pattern as bodyweight walking lunge, dumbbells held at sides.

name: Sandbag Lunge
cue_notes: Hyrox-specific carry-adjacent lunge variant, bag held front-rack or shouldered.

name: Step-Up
cue_notes: Drive through the lead foot, avoid pushing off the trailing leg.

name: Wall Ball
cue_notes: Hyrox station movement — squat depth then extend through the throw, catch and re-load.

name: Machine Leg Press
cue_notes: Fully supported squat pattern, good entry point or fatigue-management substitute.

name: Machine Leg Extension
cue_notes: Knee-extension isolation, useful accessory but not a squat substitute for main lift work.

name: Pistol Squat
cue_notes: Highest coordination-demand squat variant — full single-leg depth with the free leg extended.

name: Cossack Squat
cue_notes: Lateral squat, builds adductor length and ankle mobility under load.

name: Deep Squat Hold
cue_notes: Sit in the bottom position, rock gently, opens hips and ankles.

name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
cue_notes: Push hips back, bar stays close to the legs, feel the hamstring stretch.

name: Barbell Deadlift
cue_notes: Brace before pulling the slack out of the bar, drive the floor away.

name: Trap Bar Deadlift
cue_notes: More upright torso than a straight bar deadlift, easier entry point for beginners.

name: Hip Thrust
cue_notes: Primary RDL substitute in competition-proximal running phases — glute-dominant, low spinal shear.

name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
cue_notes: Same as hip thrust, one foot planted — higher glute demand per side.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
cue_notes: Same hinge pattern as barbell RDL, dumbbells travel along the outside of the legs.

name: Dumbbell Single-Leg Deadlift
cue_notes: Hinge at the hip while the free leg extends back, hips stay square.

name: Kettlebell Swing
cue_notes: Hip-hinge power movement — snap the hips, arms are just along for the ride.

name: Kettlebell Single-Arm Swing
cue_notes: Same swing pattern, added anti-rotation demand through the core.

name: Good Morning
cue_notes: Bar on back, hinge forward keeping a soft knee bend, hamstrings load progressively.

name: Machine Leg Curl
cue_notes: Isolated hamstring accessory, useful for lengthened-position hamstring strain prevention work.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
cue_notes: Eccentric-focused, high-value for runners — control the lowering, push back up if able.

name: Glute Bridge
cue_notes: Entry-level hip extension pattern, good regression from hip thrust.

name: Kettlebell Sumo Deadlift
cue_notes: Wide stance, kettlebell between the feet, good beginner hinge pattern.

name: Bodyweight Hip Hinge Drill
cue_notes: Dowel along the spine, teach the hip hinge pattern before loading it.

name: Barbell Bench Press
cue_notes: Shoulder blades pinched, feet planted, bar path stays consistent.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
cue_notes: Greater range of motion than barbell, independent arm control.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
cue_notes: Bench at 30-45 degrees, shifts emphasis to upper chest.

name: Push-Up
cue_notes: Body stays rigid, elbows track at roughly 45 degrees from the torso.

name: Incline Push-Up
cue_notes: Hands elevated on a box or bench, regression from standard push-up.

name: Deficit Push-Up
cue_notes: Hands on blocks or plates, extra range of motion increases demand.

name: Cable Chest Press
cue_notes: Constant tension through the range, easier on the shoulder than free weight pressing.

name: Machine Chest Press
cue_notes: Fully supported pressing pattern, good entry point.

name: Cable Fly
cue_notes: Slight elbow bend maintained, focus on the chest squeeze at the midline.

name: Dumbbell Fly
cue_notes: Wide arc, don't let the shoulders roll forward at the bottom.

name: Landmine Chest Press
cue_notes: Arcing press path, shoulder-friendly alternative to flat bench.

name: Barbell Overhead Press
cue_notes: Brace hard, bar path stays close to the face, lock out overhead.

name: Landmine Press
cue_notes: Primary overhead press substitute when cervical spine is involved — arcing path avoids end-range overhead lockout.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
cue_notes: Independent arm path, slightly more shoulder-friendly than a barbell.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
cue_notes: Back supported, removes lower-body drive, isolates the shoulder press.

name: Push Press
cue_notes: Dip and drive from the legs, higher power output than a strict press.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
cue_notes: Fully supported vertical press, good entry point or fatigue-management substitute.

name: Pike Push-Up
cue_notes: Hips high, bodyweight vertical press pattern, precursor to handstand push-up.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
cue_notes: Lead with the elbows, raise to shoulder height, control the descent.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
cue_notes: Constant tension version of the lateral raise, cable behind the body.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
cue_notes: Hinge forward, row to the lower ribs, avoid using momentum.

name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row
cue_notes: Same hinge position as barbell row, dumbbells allow independent arm paths.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
cue_notes: Supporting hand and knee on a bench, row straight up to the hip.

name: Cable Seated Row
cue_notes: Chest up throughout, row to the sternum, squeeze the shoulder blades.

name: TRX Row
cue_notes: Bodyweight row, adjust difficulty by changing body angle.

name: Inverted Row
cue_notes: Body under a bar, pull chest to bar, adjust height for difficulty.

name: Chest-Supported Row
cue_notes: Chest braced against the pad, removes lower back demand entirely.

name: Band Pull-Apart
cue_notes: Shoulder health accessory, pull the band apart at chest height, squeeze shoulder blades.

name: Face Pull
cue_notes: Pull to the face, external rotation at the top, key shoulder health accessory.

name: Pull-Up
cue_notes: Full hang to chin over the bar, avoid excessive kipping unless training for it specifically.

name: Chin-Up
cue_notes: Underhand grip, slightly more biceps involvement than a pull-up.

name: Banded Pull-Up
cue_notes: Band assists at the bottom of the rep, standard regression toward a strict pull-up.

name: Lat Pulldown
cue_notes: Pull to the upper chest, avoid leaning back excessively.

name: Single-Arm Lat Pulldown
cue_notes: Same pattern as lat pulldown, isolates one side at a time.

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
cue_notes: Arms stay straight, isolates the lats without elbow flexion.

name: Farmer's Carry
cue_notes: Hyrox station movement — braced core, tall posture, controlled steps.

name: Farmer's Carry Dumbbell
cue_notes: Same pattern as kettlebell farmer's carry, using dumbbells.

name: Suitcase Carry
cue_notes: Single-side load, resist the lateral lean — direct anti-lateral-flexion core work.

name: Front Rack Carry
cue_notes: Load held at the shoulders, higher core and upper back demand than a farmer's carry.

name: Overhead Carry
cue_notes: Load locked out overhead, walk with control — high shoulder stability demand.

name: Sandbag Carry
cue_notes: Awkward, shifting load — builds carry capacity beyond symmetric implements.

name: Sled Push
cue_notes: Hyrox station movement — low shin angle, drive through full foot contact, short powerful steps.

name: Sled Pull
cue_notes: Hyrox station movement — walk backward or use a rope, controlled hand-over-hand pull.

name: Cable Woodchopper
cue_notes: Rotate through the torso and hips together, pull diagonally across the body.

name: Medicine Ball Rotational Throw
cue_notes: Explosive rotation, throw against a wall, load and release quickly.

name: Russian Twist
cue_notes: Seated, feet elevated optionally, rotate the torso side to side under control.

name: Landmine Rotation
cue_notes: Arms extended holding the bar end, rotate side to side driven from the hips.

name: Pallof Press
cue_notes: Resist the cable's pull to rotate you, press straight out and back with control.

name: Band Pallof Press
cue_notes: Same as cable Pallof press, using a band anchored to a rack.

name: Single-Arm Farmer's Carry
cue_notes: Same as suitcase carry — resist lateral flexion and rotation from the offset load.

name: Half-Kneeling Cable Press
cue_notes: Half-kneeling position removes hip compensation, resist rotation while pressing.

name: Plank
cue_notes: Ribs down, glutes engaged, avoid letting the hips sag or pike.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
cue_notes: Roll out only as far as you can maintain a braced, flat spine.

name: Stability Ball Rollout
cue_notes: Regression from the ab wheel — same movement pattern, more stable surface.

name: Dead Bug
cue_notes: Lower back stays pressed into the floor throughout, opposite arm and leg extend together.

name: Hollow Body Hold
cue_notes: Lower back pressed flat, shoulders and legs lifted, maintain the position.

name: Barbell Rollout
cue_notes: Same pattern as ab wheel, using a loaded barbell for more control over resistance.

name: Bear Crawl
cue_notes: Knees hover just off the floor, move opposite arm and leg together, hips stay level.

name: Burpee
cue_notes: Full-body conditioning movement — chest to floor, explosive stand and jump.

name: Burpee Broad Jump
cue_notes: Hyrox station movement — burpee immediately followed by a maximal broad jump forward.

name: Farmer's Carry Walk
cue_notes: Loaded walking, distinct from the carry-strength focus — used as a conditioning gait drill.

name: Skater Jump
cue_notes: Lateral bound side to side, land softly and control before the next jump.

name: Box Jump
cue_notes: Full extension at takeoff, land softly with knees tracking over toes.

name: Broad Jump
cue_notes: Horizontal power expression, land under control absorbing through the hips.

name: Sprint (Track/Treadmill)
cue_notes: Top of the concurrent-training hierarchy for runners — maximal or near-maximal effort.

name: Ski Erg
cue_notes: Hyrox station movement — preferred conditioning substitution on upper-body pull days over rowing.

name: Rowing Erg
cue_notes: Hyrox station movement — legs drive first, then hips, then arms; avoid stacking directly after heavy pulling work.

name: 90/90 Hip Switch
cue_notes: Rotate through the hips from one 90/90 position to the other, keep the torso tall.

name: Thoracic Rotation (Quadruped)
cue_notes: On all fours, thread one arm under the body and rotate open, follow with the eyes.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
cue_notes: Lunge with a rotation and reach, covers hip flexor, thoracic spine, and hamstring in one drill.

name: Couch Stretch
cue_notes: Rear knee bent against a wall or bench, target the hip flexor.

name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Mobilization
cue_notes: Knee drives over the toes without the heel lifting, builds ankle range for squat depth.

name: Foam Roller Quad Smash
cue_notes: Slow rolling pressure through the quads, pause on tender spots.

name: Shoulder Dislocate (Band/Dowel)
cue_notes: Wide grip, pass the band or dowel overhead and behind without bending the elbows.

name: Cat-Cow
cue_notes: Alternate between spinal flexion and extension slowly, on all fours.

name: Barbell Bicep Curl
cue_notes: Elbows pinned to the sides, curl without swinging the torso.

name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
cue_notes: Neutral grip throughout, targets brachialis and forearms alongside biceps.

name: Cable Tricep Pushdown
cue_notes: Elbows pinned at the sides, extend fully without flaring.

name: Overhead Tricep Extension
cue_notes: Elbows stay close to the head, lower behind the head under control.

name: Bodyweight Calf Raise
cue_notes: Full range, pause at the top — priority accessory for runners' calf/soleus loading.

name: Seated Calf Raise
cue_notes: Seated position biases the soleus more than a standing calf raise.

name: Cable Glute Kickback
cue_notes: Isolated hip extension, avoid arching the lower back to gain range.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Lunge
cue_notes: Step wide to one side, sit back into that hip, opposite leg stays straight.
